description: Per-RF-chain ergodic DL/UL sum rates [Gbit/s], DELIVERED, i.e. already including the full eq (2.40) pre-log tau_i*(1-tau_sig), average load and effective bandwidth, exactly as produced by the rate model (Fig 2c). The power figures consume these directly and apply no further factor, so the pre-log cannot be double-counted. Indexed positionally with M_RF (reused for M_ant in the fully-digital sweep). Seed values are the paper's reference results (the original raw rates [1.6, 3.64, ...] / [1.02, ...] times the 0.93 = (1-tau_sig) pre-log component); overwrite them by running rate_model.compute_and_save.
